reporting_basis: SOLO / STANDALONE. Determined 2026-08-26 by matching this dataset's recorded total assets against the bank's own annual report Balance Sheet columns. Evidence: FY2022 total assets of 712,755.71m (as recorded for 2022_Q4 in this dataset, from the prior session's extraction) exactly matches the 'BALANCE SHEET as at 31 December 2022' (unconsolidated) heading's Total Assets of BDT 712,755,711,836 in pubalibank-annual-report-2022.txt (line 18422); the 'CONSOLIDATED BALANCE SHEET as at 31 December 2022' in the same report (line 17900) shows a different figure, BDT 714,272,726,951 (714,272.73m). The same pattern is independently confirmed for FY2013 and FY2014 via pubalibank-annual-report-2014.txt's own explicit 'Balance Sheet as at 31 December 2014' (unconsolidated), which reproduces both years exactly (2014: 248,386.50m; 2013: 228,533.77m) versus its separate 'Consolidated Balance Sheet as at 31 December 2014' section. FY2025's press-triangulated figures (see 2025 source entry) could NOT be confirmed against a Solo/Consolidated split since the primary PDF was inaccessible — at least one FY2025 figure (operating profit) was explicitly reported by press as 'consolidated' — so treat FY2025 line items with caution regarding basis purity; all other years (2011-2024) are Solo-confirmed or Solo-consistent. ADDENDUM 2026-08-26: the separate 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board' table used to source FY2017-2020 Q1/Q2/Q3 (see the dedicated source entry below) was independently basis-checked against this same determination and confirmed to also be SOLO/STANDALONE -- its own Dec-year-end Total Assets and Total Shareholders' Equity match the Solo-confirmed 2018_Q4.json/2019_Q4.json figures exactly to the taka, and its introductory text refers only to 'the Bank' (not 'the Bank and its subsidiaries'), unlike the Consolidated 'Business Segment' table immediately following it in the same report. No basis mismatch between the Q1-Q3 source and the main series.
notes: annual_reports/PUBALIBANK archive (2011-2024, 14 years) was already text-extracted by a parallel session working on this project; the FY2023 and FY2024 report extracts are unusually short/partial (105 and 1,598 lines respectively, vs 28,000-31,000 for other years), suggesting an interrupted or targeted re-extraction rather than the full report. Complete Q4/year-end coverage for FY2011-2024 achieved from four overlapping annual reports' 'Key Financial Information'/'Balance Sheet Parameters'/'Key Financials' sections plus each of FY2023/FY2024's own (partial) Balance Sheet extracts. FY2025 (see its source entry) uses press/secondary sources in place of a primary document because pubalibangla.com is now Cloudflare-protected. Q4/year-end (audited) data covers FY2011-2025; Q1/Q2/Q3 (unaudited interim) data is available for FY2017-2020 via an embedded annual-report table (richest source, includes balance sheet), and -- as of 2026-08-27 -- ALSO for FY2011-2016, FY2021, FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 (Q1/Q2 only) and bonus FY2026 (Q1/Q2 only) via DSE's own company-page interim table recovered through Wayback Machine captures (thinner, EPS/turnover/price-level only; see the dedicated 'DSE interim table (Wayback)' source entry). FY2022 Q1-Q3 is the one remaining fully-confirmed gap (see its dedicated source entry).

sources.source_document: pubalibank-annual-report-2014.txt ("Key Financial Information" 5-year table, pages 55-56, and own "Balance Sheet as at 31 December 2014", page 70), cross-validated against pubalibank-annual-report-2012.txt and pubalibank-annual-report-2013.txt's own "Key Financials" tables
sources.note: The 2015 report's own multi-year table was previously found too OCR-corrupted to use (see earlier session note, retained for context), but the FY2014 report's OWN 'Key Financial Information' table (a different document, pages 55-56) is clean and gives a full 2010-2014 span; it was used instead. Every figure was cross-validated: (a) FY2011 exactly matches independent contemporaneous columns in both the FY2012 and FY2013 reports' own tables (Total Deposits, Total Advances, Total Assets, three-way exact match) — the FY2011 report's own table was NOT used because it has OCR digit-corruption (e.g. its own 2011 Total Advances column reads a garbled 106,229.49 instead of 106,329.63). (b) FY2013 and FY2014 total assets/liabilities were independently confirmed against pubalibank-annual-report-2014.txt's own explicit unconsolidated 'Balance Sheet as at 31 December 2014' statement, which reproduces both years' figures to the taka. (c) Every year's paid-up-capital+reserves=equity, classified-loans/loans=NPL%, loans/deposits=LDR%, actual-capital/RWA=CAR%, Tier1+Tier2=actual-capital, and required-capital=10%-of-RWA identities were recomputed and reconciled exactly for FY2012-2014, and for all but one figure in FY2011 (see below). DISCOVERY - systematic profit-before-tax mislabeling: the FY2012 and FY2013 reports' own abbreviated 'Key Financials' tables label a figure as 'Pre-tax Profit' (e.g. 6,135.80 for FY2012) that is actually pre-PROVISION operating profit, not true profit-before-tax. This was proven by (i) an effective-tax-rate plausibility check — treating 6,135.80 as FY2012's PBT against its Net Profit of 1,761.98 implies an impossible 71.3% effective tax rate — and (ii) an exact independent reconciliation via the FY2014 report's own Value Added Statement, which for both FY2013 and FY2014 shows 'corporate tax + deferred tax' exactly equal to (the FY2014 table's separate 'Profit before tax' row) minus (Net profit after tax), to the hundred-thousand-taka. The FY2014 table's own 'Profit before tax' row (distinct from its 'Operating profit' row) is therefore used for profit_before_tax in all four backfilled years, with the formerly-mislabeled figure recorded instead as gross_profit (operating profit). DATA QUALITY FLAG - unresolved: FY2011's own reported car_pct (11.56%) does not reconcile with the same table's own actual_capital/RWA (17,976.71 / 132,581.60 = 13.56%), a ~2pp internal inconsistency unique to that one column (FY2012-2014 all reconcile car_pct exactly to actual_capital/RWA). The literal reported 11.56% was kept (see 2011_Q4.json period_note) since there is no independent third source, unlike the profit-before-tax case, to determine which single figure in that column is the error.

sources.source_document: No primary source document obtained. Figures triangulated from press coverage of the bank's FY2025 audited/AGM-approved results and the stockanalysis.com data aggregator.
sources.note: PRIMARY SOURCE BLOCKED: pubalibangla.com is now behind a Cloudflare 'Performing security verification' JS challenge that returned HTTP 403 to every fetch method tried this session: direct curl (default UA, a full browser UA, and a Googlebot UA), WebFetch, the r.jina.ai reader proxy (which itself hit the same Cloudflare challenge page server-side), and Wayback Machine's live Save-Page-Now trigger (HTTP 520, meaning Wayback's own fetcher could not reach the origin either). The FY2025 Annual Report's existence and exact URL were confirmed via Google's search index (https://pubalibangla.com/assets/pdf/Financial_Reports/annual_reports/Annual_Report_2025.pdf, indexed title 'Integrated Annual Report 2025') but the bytes could not be retrieved by any available tool. Wayback Machine's CDX index has no capture of this URL, and no capture at all of any pubalibangla.com page after 2025-07-23 (i.e. before the FY2025 report was even published, per its 43rd AGM being held 2026-06-16). static.bonikbarta.com mirrors some banks' FS PDFs without Cloudflare protection (confirmed working — used to spot-check-download Pubali Bank's own FY2024 FS, Pubali-Bank-FS-2024.pdf, 22.6MB) but has no 2025 mirror yet for Pubali Bank or five other major DSE banks tested (all 404). dsebd.org's PUBALIBANK company page does not host the document itself, only a dead-end link back to the blocked pubalibangla.com page. sharebazarnews.com also returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch (its own bot protection, independent of Pubali Bank's). archive.today returned HTTP 429 (rate-limited) on a single attempt, not retried. Given this, FY2025 figures are drawn from: Daily New Nation/UNB wire (https://dailynewnation.com/news/835660), The Daily Corporate (https://en.thedailycorporate.com/pubali-bank-joins-tk1000-crore-profit-club-with-record-earnings-in-2025/), Bonik Barta in Bangla (https://bonikbarta.com/economy/8RTXotV7TNWSd5Lo), and stockanalysis.com (https://stockanalysis.com/quote/dse/PUBALIBANK/financials/balance-sheet/) for total_liabilities/total_equity only, plus headline NPL/dividend corroboration from The Daily Star, Financial Express, Dhaka Tribune and The Business Standard via search-result summaries (direct WebFetch of tbsnews.net/dhakatribune.com/thedailystar.net/thefinancialexpress.com.bd was independently blocked by their own bot protection, HTTP 403, unrelated to the Pubali Bank block). Full detail on which figure came from which source, and every unreconciled cross-source discrepancy (total_assets 0.29% gap vs stockanalysis.com; gross_loans vs stockanalysis.com's higher 'Gross Loans'/lower 'Net Loans'; two EPS values; two dividend-percentage claims; excluded paid-up-capital and NAVPS due to a ~20% internal inconsistency when cross-checked), is in 2025_Q4.json's period_note. This entire year's entry carries materially lower confidence than every other year in this dataset and should be re-extracted from the primary PDF once accessible.

sources.source_document: pubalibank-annual-report-2018.txt (Q1-Q3 2017 via its own '2017' comparative column, since pubalibank-annual-report-2017.txt's own version of this table is OCR-corrupted; Q1-Q3 2018 via its own current-year columns), pubalibank-annual-report-2019.txt (Q1-Q3 2019 own current-year columns; also supplies the FY2018 Fixed Assets figures missing from the 2018 report's own corrupted row), pubalibank-annual-report-2020.txt (Q1-Q3 2020 own current-year columns, partial extraction)
sources.note: RESOLVES the Q1/Q2/Q3 gap below for 4 of the ~14 researchable years. All 14 available PUBALIBANK annual report text extracts (FY2011-2024; pubalibangla.com itself is Cloudflare-blocked, per the FY2025 entry above, so no live retrieval was attempted or possible) were searched for the BSEC-mandated corporate-governance disclosure table titled 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board' (most banks answer the underlying BSEC CG Code item 1.5(ix) with only a checkbox; Pubali Bank instead publishes a full Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 balance-sheet-and-cumulative-income data table). FOUND in FY2017, FY2018, FY2019, FY2020 reports only -- one more year (FY2017) than a prior research pass had flagged (which found only FY2018-2020) -- confirmed absent (checkbox-only, or in FY2023's case a 105-line stub with no such section at all) in FY2011-2016, FY2021, FY2022, FY2023, FY2024 via three independent markers (the table heading itself, the phrase 'Committee and by the Board', and the 'Business Segment' table that immediately follows this table in every year that has it, none of which appear in the other 10 years' text). REPORTING BASIS: Solo/Standalone, matching PUBALIBANK's main series -- confirmed by exact match (to the taka) between this table's own Dec-year-end Total Assets/Total Shareholders' Equity and the independently-sourced 2018_Q4.json/2019_Q4.json figures, and by the table's own text referring only to 'the Bank' (not 'the Bank and its subsidiaries'), distinct from the Consolidated 'Business Segment' table immediately following it. INCOME-STATEMENT FIGURES ARE CUMULATIVE FROM JAN 1 (not discrete-quarter), per each quarter file's _cumulative-suffixed metrics, matching CITYBANK's established convention -- never derived by inter-quarter subtraction. DATA QUALITY FINDINGS (full detail in each year's quarterly JSON period_note): (1) FY2018's own report has one corrupted row (Fixed Assets) recovered instead from the FY2019 report's comparative column, cross-validated exact on Dec-18. (2) EPS for all four FY2018 quarters was later retrospectively restated DOWNWARD in the FY2019 report's comparative column (e.g. Dec-18: 3.43 here vs 3.33 there) while Net Profit After Tax is byte-for-byte identical in both -- diagnostic of a BAS-33 bonus-share retrospective EPS restatement; contemporaneous (FY2018-report) values were kept, per project convention. (3) The FY2020 report's own version of this table is a PARTIAL extraction (roughly half its rows missing in a near-perfectly-alternating pattern, most likely a pdftotext/layout artifact since the FY2018/FY2019 versions of the identical table extracted cleanly) -- total_assets recovered via the table's own 'Total liabilities and shareholders' equity' row (definitionally equal to total assets), total_equity derived from that minus Total Liabilities (both reported in the same table); Investments, Balance-with-other-banks, Fixed Assets, Subordinated Bond, Other Liabilities, Off-Balance-Sheet Items, Total Operating Income, and Profit-before-provision could not be recovered for FY2020 and are omitted rather than guessed. (4) Cross-checking the FY2020 report's Dec-19 COMPARATIVE column against the FY2019 report's own Dec-19 figures found a genuine ~3.72bn (8.8%) restatement in Other Assets/Total Assets (Total Liabilities unchanged, Deposits ~266m/0.07% lower) -- confined to the Dec/full-year column only; every Q1-Q3 interim column cross-checked EXACT across every year-pair compared in this research pass, which is why the FY2020 Q1-Q3 figures in this dataset are still judged usable despite this Dec-specific caution. (5) VALIDATION FLAGS -- two genuine (non-error) Q4 reversals surfaced by checking monotonicity of cumulative income Q1->Q2->Q3->Q4: FY2017 cumulative Net Profit rises through Q3 (1,188.70m) then swings to a full-year LOSS (already known from 2017_Q4.json, EPS -0.28) implying a ~-1,469.9m discrete Q4 loss, corroborated by the equity roll-forward in this same table; FY2019 cumulative Net Profit peaks at Sep-19 (2,570.68m) then falls to 2,143.27m for the full year, implying a ~-427.4m discrete Q4 loss, also corroborated by the equity roll-forward. Both are flagged in the respective quarters' period_notes and in insights.json, not silently smoothed over. ratios_timeseries.json was extended with ldr_pct/roa_pct/roe_pct (basis calculated / calculated_period_end_not_average, matching CITYBANK's own established convention for its Q1-Q3 rows) and yoy_growth_pct (computable for FY2018-2020 Q1-Q3 against the newly-added FY2017-2019 same-quarter figures; null for FY2017 Q1-Q3 since no FY2016 same-quarter data exists in this table).

sources.period: 2011-2016, 2021, 2023-2026 Q1/Q2/Q3 (unaudited interim) -- DSE interim table via Wayback Machine
sources.note: Researched 2026-08-27, applying the technique first proven on RUPALIBANK: DSE's own company page (dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=PUBALIBANK) carries a live 'Interim Financial Performance: <year>' table that only ever shows the CURRENT interim year, rolling over once that year's own annual report is finalized (around the bank's AGM, typically Mar-Jun). Wayback Machine captures of this exact URL taken at different past dates each freeze a different 'current year', letting real historical quarters be reconstructed with zero access to pubalibangla.com. A full CDX sweep found captures back to 2008 (far earlier than needed); one capture per target year was fetched and parsed (see the consolidated text file for every capture's raw table and timestamp). RESULTS: FY2011-2015 recovered from an OLDER 4-column table vintage (titled 'Financial Performance: <year>', no 'Interim' prefix) giving Turnover, Net-Profit-After-Tax(continuing operations), Basic/Diluted EPS and NAV-per-share, ALL CUMULATIVE FROM JAN 1 (Q1=3mo/Q2=6mo/Q3=9mo per the table's own headers) -- richer than the later table vintage, but with no period-end price. FY2016 onward uses the same 6-column 'Interim Financial Performance' table already documented for RUPALIBANK (Q1 | Q2 discrete | Half-Yearly cumulative | Q3 discrete | 9-Months cumulative | Annual), which for FY2023 onward stopped publishing Turnover/Profit-in-BDT (EPS and price only, matching RUPALIBANK's identical 2023 presentation change exactly). FY2022 is a CONFIRMED Wayback gap: the only two 2022-dated captures in the CDX index return HTTP 403 and HTTP 302 respectively (no HTTP 200 capture exists anywhere in 2022), and the next viable capture jumps straight to Oct 2023, by which point the page had already rolled past 2022 -- this is not a search failure, it is a genuine missing capture (see the memory-documented caveat that this can happen for one specific year even with adjacent years present). DISCOVERED PATTERN (new, see insights.json): PUBALIBANK's AGM falls Mar-Jun, between Q1 and Q2 of the same year; in years the AGM declares a bonus/stock share dividend (2011, 2014, 2024, 2025, 2026 confirmed via share-count evidence), Q1's EPS is computed on the pre-bonus share count while Q2/Half-Yearly use the post-bonus count without retroactive Q1 restatement, so Q1(discrete)+Q2(discrete) does not sum to the reported Half-Yearly figure in those years (gaps of 0.18-0.28 BDT/share in 2024-2026) -- recorded as reported in every affected quarter file, not silently reconciled. Cash-dividend-only years (2013, 2015, 2016) reconcile exactly. FY2021 additionally surfaced (a) a genuine cross-capture instability in the ambiguous 'Turnover/Revenue' field specifically (785.41 in a 2021-06-09 capture vs 5623.83 in a 2021-11-02 capture for the SAME nominal Q1 2021, while Profit was identical in both) -- Turnover is therefore omitted from all of FY2021's quarter files as a conservative, consistent choice; and (b) the same DSE 'Mismatch is due to issuers own actual disclosure' tooltip pattern already seen on RUPALIBANK, flagging Q3/9-Months Turnover and Profit (both excluded as non-disclosure) while leaving Q3's own EPS (2.720) unflagged and credible (kept). FY2024's Q3 has a specific sub-gap: discrete EPS is blank/dash in the source even though 9-Months cumulative EPS and Q3's own period-end price are both given -- recorded as-is, not back-derived by subtraction. FY2025 Q3 and beyond had not occurred/were not yet capturable as of the latest usable (HTTP 200) capture (2025-08-25); FY2026 Q1-Q2 was recovered via a live (non-Wayback) fetch of the current page as a bonus beyond this task's original scope, mirroring the RUPALIBANK precedent of also capturing current-year data when reachable.

CONFIRMED gap, not merely unsearched: the Wayback CDX index for dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=PUBALIBANK contains exactly two 2022-dated captures (2022-02-13, HTTP 403 as archived; 2022-04-24, HTTP 302 as archived) and no capture with HTTP 200 anywhere in 2022 -- the next viable (200-status) capture is 2023-10-29, which by then already displays the '2023' interim table, meaning FY2022 had rolled off the page before any usable capture was taken. The DSE Auditors_opinion repository (see below) also has no PUBALIBANK entry for 2022 or any other year. FY2022 Q1-Q3 (and, in this dataset, all interim/annual detail for FY2022 beyond whatever the bank's own annual report -- already covered by the main Q4 series -- discloses) remains a genuine, fully-exhausted gap.

sources.period: All years -- DSE Auditors_opinion repository check
sources.note: Tried https://dsebd.org/Auditors_opinion/<year>/PUBALIBANK_<year>.pdf directly (a different DSE resource from the interim table above, per the technique memo -- this is where RUPALIBANK's own FY2023/FY2024 qualified-opinion excerpts were found) for year in {2011,2012,2013,2014,2015,2016,2017,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024,2025}, plus casing variants and the numeric scrip code (11106) -- ALL returned HTTP 404. The identical URL pattern against a bank confirmed to have an entry (dsebd.org/Auditors_opinion/2024/RUPALIBANK_2024.pdf) returned HTTP 200 (a real 13-page PDF), confirming the path construction is correct and the 404s are not a technique error. This repository most likely exists specifically for companies with a qualified/adverse/disclaimer audit opinion requiring special DSE disclosure (consistent with RUPALIBANK's severely distressed CRAR/provisioning history); PUBALIBANK has no qualified-opinion history anywhere else in this dataset and most likely simply has no entries here for any year. Recorded so a future session does not re-attempt this fruitlessly.
